name: ai.apature/mcp-review
description: In-loop, read-only design review for coding agents: inspect a verified preview, return grounded findings with element refs and fixes, and recheck the agent's fix before CI.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token> or an OAuth-issued access token. See docs/install.md.

_meta.ai.apature/read_only_boundary: Customer-facing: the server judges, explains, and verifies. It never edits code, commits, pushes, or opens pull requests. Submit and recheck create metered jobs; only design_review_get is read-only.
